EVERY LAYER PASSES ARBITRARY FIELDS THROUGH. The only thing that ever dropped weighted fields was the projexa component.
BACKEND WEIGHTED ENGINE IS COMPLETE AND CORRECT - do not rebuild. computeHierarchicalAmount walks to the ROOT ancestor; a sub-task's own qty/rate are never used in its amount, so 0/0 is correct not a fudge. It throws 400 if parentItemCode has null breakdownPercentage, or if parentItemCode matches no itemCode IN THE SAME SUBMISSION. createBoqRevision inserts lineItems wholesale then diffs; it can throw 409 scope-reduction with an allowScopeReductionOverride escape hatch which the UI surfaces as an explicit override button.

=== 10b. SHELL MODEL - RAJAT CLARIFIED 20 AUG AFTER TESTING THE LIVE UI ===
TWO SCREENS ONLY. LEFT = INSTRUCTION SCREEN (VERI Chat + Task Master + AI Assistant). RIGHT = VISUAL SCREEN where the human sees real work, reports and analysis. The sidebar nav rail goes away.
NAVIGATION RULE: selecting a mode pill opens the matching page on the RIGHT. Selecting option 1 opens its page, option 2 opens its page, and so on down the chain. The human then either instructs the AI to finish the job or does it himself on the right. THE LEFT PANEL DRIVES THE RIGHT PANEL AT EVERY LEVEL.
RAJAT PRINCIPLE, RECORD IT: "humans dont need constant interaction". In an ERP the human gives a command and the software turns it into a TASK. The assistant DEFAULTS TO DOING AND REPORTING, NOT CONVERSING. Every extra turn it demands is a design failure. The right screen exists to give the human a feeling of control.
END OF DAY the human wants ONE view: x of y tasks done.

DECISION TAKEN BY claude-chat, DELEGATED BY RAJAT - WHAT IS A TASK vs WHAT IS ONLY CHAT:
EVERY instruction still gets a task ID (D-14, audit trail). ONLY WORK WITH A COMPLETION STATE IS DISPLAYED IN TASK MASTER. If lookups appear in the list the end-of-day count becomes meaningless.
DISPLAY AS A TASK: anything that WRITES to the ERP; anything that cannot finish now (missing info, needs a file, needs approval); anything assigned to another person; anything deferred to a date; anything that FAILED OR WAS REFUSED - the D-6 gap log becomes a task so nothing is lost silently.
CHAT ONLY, NOT DISPLAYED: questions and lookups; navigation; clarification inside an already-open task; anything the software completes instantly with no side effect.
STATUS SET - FIVE, NO MORE: To Do / In Progress / Waiting (on a person or document) / Done / Blocked. The mock already carries five colour dots.
EXTRA COLUMN THE MOCK LACKS: WHO EXECUTES - Software, AI, or a named person. That is what makes "95% software, 5% AI" visible instead of claimed.
END-OF-DAY VIEW: Done today / Still open / Blocked - BLOCKED FIRST, it is the only column that needs the human.
